The '''explosive briefcase''' was an explosive device that was disguised to look like a briefcase. They were used by the [[Wayfar spies]] and in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] obtained one of them.

==Behind the scenes==
The Explosive briefcase featured in the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', in the collection quest ''Wayfar Spy Collection''.
